issues.description: Method parameter type contradiction for addGuestStudents. The problem statement's task text (problem_statement.md line 49) instructs students to "Implement a addGuestStudents(String) method", whereas the UML in the same problem statement (problem_statement.md line 73) and the reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 90) declare addGuestStudents(int) returning void. This mismatch leaves students uncertain which parameter type to implement and will cause test or compilation failures if they follow the textual instruction (String) while tests expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the problem statement consistent with the UML and solution. Change the textual instruction at problem_statement.md line 49 from "Implement a addGuestStudents(String) method" to "Implement a addGuestStudents(int) method" and update any other textual examples accordingly so the parameter type matches the UML (+addGuestStudents(int): void) and the reference implementation.
